name: East African Cables Plc
source: East African Cables Plc audited results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2024 (NSE filing, audited by KPMG, audit report dated 25 April 2025). KShs thousands as filed, stored in KES. Operating Expenses is the sum of factory, administrative and selling and distribution expenses plus depreciation and amortisation and the net impairment charge, so gross profit plus other income less operating expenses equals Results from Operating Activities. Income Tax is the tax credit for the year. | CRON 20261013: H1 2025 column added from the East African Cables Plc interim financial statement summary for the six months ended 30 June 2025 (issuer interim filing, as carried by AfricanFinancials HY2025, cross-checked against The Online Kenyan half year report): revenue 1,231,614,000, net loss 190,151,000, loss per share 0.53. Cost of sales, gross profit, profit before tax and income tax are left empty: the interim summary does not print the split, and the company is under administration so the period carries no audited comparatives. | CRON 20261112: H1 2025 column completed from the NSE-filed interim statement (turnover 1 231 614; cost of sales 852 642; gross profit 378 972; loss before tax 283 595; loss for the period 190 151).
source_note: Gap fill 2026-10-13: Profit Before Tax, Net Profit and EPS read from the East African Cables 2024 annual report and abridged results (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-cabl-2024-ar-00/): loss before tax 536,429 thousand, loss after tax 358,762 thousand, basic and diluted EPS -0.98. The income tax figure is the difference between the two printed losses, a credit of 177,667 thousand, and is tagged derived. Note that the stored shares outstanding of 253,130,000 does not divide into the printed loss after tax to give the printed EPS, which implies the share count carried on the file is stale; the EPS stored here is the issuers own printed figure and was not recomputed. | earlier note: Figures read from the consolidated statement of profit or loss in the audited 2024 results announcement. rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.source: East African Cables Plc interim financial statements, unaudited results for the six months ended 30 June 2025, condensed statement of comprehensive income, Group column, KShs thousands (https://www.nse.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/East-African-Cable-Announcement-of-2025-Half-year-unaudited-Results.pdf). Turnover 1 231 614; cost of sales (852 642); gross profit 378 972; operating expenses (295 361); profit from operations 83 611; impairment write-back (12 000); depreciation and amortisation (94 105); loss from operating activities (22 494); interest expense (261 101); net exchange losses nil; loss before tax (283 595); income tax credit 93 444; loss for the period (190 151); loss per share (0.53) Kenyan shillings. CRON 20261112: H1 2025 Cost of Sales filled with 852 642, Gross Profit 378 972, Operating Expenses 401 466 (operating expenses plus impairment plus depreciation, the same composition the FY2024 column uses), Operating Profit (EBIT) (22 494) which is the printed loss from operating activities and equals gross profit less that expense total, Net Finance Costs 261 101, Profit Before Tax (283 595) and Income Tax (93 444) whose sign follows the file convention of profit before tax less profit for the period. Gross profit less operating expenses equals operating profit, and operating profit less net finance costs equals the printed loss before taxation, both exactly.
